market_story: ERCOT's real 2024/2025 battery fleet was bigger than the EIA-860 operable schedule shows — COD energization runs ahead of the schedule's month grain and hybrid battery halves are under-covered — and ERCOT's own DAM ledger (registered non-OUT HSL) is the market-faithful record of what SCED could actually call on. With that measured capability at the evening scarcity margin, the co-optimization holds the cushion reality had: the Aug-2024 tight evenings clear deep in the ORDC (as the real market did at $3,060 max) instead of shedding load at VOLL, and the Jul/Aug-2025 evenings clear near the measured $243 ceiling instead of printing $250-1,944 phantom plateaus. The same capability lets batteries run closer to their measured throughput (4.33 vs 5.46 TWh 2025). What the bigger fleet no longer papers over is the model's real 2024 under-pricing away from events (May/Nov shoulder evenings) — the exposed root-cause lane this keeper hands to its successor.
